title: Search Insert Position
statement:
Given a sorted array of distinct integers and a target value, return the index if the target is found. If not, return the index where it would be inserted in order.
You must write an algorithm with O(log n) runtime.
hints: This is binary search that returns `low` when the loop ends.
When nums[mid] < target, the insert point is to the right of mid.
When the target is missing, `low` lands on the first index greater than target.
